axes_source: Read from data/brands/zapier.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FF4F00 and the canvas #FFFEFB; contrast from the ink #201515 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FF4F00; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 6, 12px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #FF4F00 reaches 3.27:1 on the canvas #FFFEFB, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: Zapier
